SELECT g.foracid         AS accountnum,
       g.acid            AS acid,
       g.cif_id          AS cifid,
       g.sol_id          AS solid,
       g.schm_code       AS schemecode,
       g.schm_type       AS schemetype,
       g.acct_name       AS accountname,
       g.acct_short_name AS shortname,
       g.acct_crncy_code AS currency,
       g.clr_bal_amt     AS balance,
       g.acct_opn_date   AS openeddate,
       g.acct_ownership  AS ownership,
       g.acct_cls_flg    AS closedflag,
       s.acct_status     AS status
FROM   tbaadm.gam g
LEFT JOIN tbaadm.smt s ON s.bank_id = g.bank_id AND s.acid = g.acid
WHERE  g.bank_id = '01'
  AND  g.del_flg = 'N'
  AND  g.entity_cre_flg = 'Y'
cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS r
WITH r WHERE r.accountnum IS NOT NULL
MERGE (n:Account {accountNumber: toString(r.accountnum)})
SET n.acid = r.acid
SET n.cifId = r.cifid
SET n.solID = r.solid
SET n.schemeCode = r.schemecode
SET n.accountType = r.schemetype
SET n.accountName = r.accountname
SET n.shortName = r.shortname
SET n.currency = r.currency
SET n.balance = r.balance
SET n.openedDate = r.openeddate
SET n.ownership = r.ownership
SET n.closedFlag = r.closedflag
SET n.status = r.status
